Our newest member of the team! We’re thrilled to welcome Rebecca to the team, as our In-House Pharmacist! 💊🤍

This is a really special addition to the Herology team because we don’t just want to make great supplements - we want to build a women’s health brand you can genuinely trust.

Women’s health is complex, supplements can interact with medications and what’s right for one woman may not be right for another. When you’re creating products designed to support women through different hormonal stages, the standard of care behind them should reflect that.

Rebecca brings a pharmacist’s perspective directly into Herology - helping us think about ingredients, medications, interactions, safety and the real questions women have when deciding what’s right for their bodies.

For us, having this expertise in-house is another important part of putting science, safety and women’s individual needs at the heart of what we do.

Welcome to Herology, Rebecca. We’re very lucky to have you! ☺️
